issue.title: Fix the athena/apollo audit findings the triage ranked worth fixing
issue.description: Apollo's and athena's managed-tmp reaper reclaims dead scratch even with SSH sessions open and read-only test trees present, and its jobs report failures truthfully. Agent cleanup works while any agent waits on an epic. `sase doctor -j` always prints JSON. Artifact-link projection converges past missing or foreign bead endpoints. Agent-hood publication drains its quarantine backlog through measured fixes and bounded retries. The TUI's multi-second GC freezes are attributed and fixed against sase-1f3's targets. Task beads sase-1bw, sase-1ne, sase-1nb, sase-1na, sase-1c5, sase-1f4, sase-1f3, sase-10x, and sase-1nc are closed with evidence, and the stalled epic sase-11o is superseded.
